query: SELECT r.id FROM scan_runs r WHERE r.provider_id = $1 AND r.mode = $2::scan_mode AND r.state IN ('queued','running') AND r.created_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $3) AND (r.total_tasks = 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scan_tasks t WHERE t.run_id = r.id AND t.state IN ('queued','claimed','running') )) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
